title: What happened to my pictures?
text: I love love LOVE this app as my personal journal throughout my relationship. I kept my pictures updated throughout my seven years of relationship, but now 90% of the pictures won’t show up in the app. They show up as blurred squares and won’t load. It’s honestly really sad to see all my photos of years disappear like that.

title: What happened?
text:
This was my review a few years ago: “For sure the best communication app for couples. My S/O and I love it. It has helped us organize in a better way, which is always a positive thing in a relationship.”

But now I’ve tried 6 months to get support and nothing. There is no response to my emails (~5) or to my direct messages through Instagram. It seems that there is no one at the other end.

title: DO. NOT. DOWNLOAD.
text:
My wife and I used this for years. Has over 40,000 photos os us. One day, they had a “glitch” that deleted 38,000 PHOTOS!! YEARS WORTH!! My wedding photos included!!

They didn’t reach out. They never apologised. They never replied to any of my emails. I had to search for hours for any information.

Idk if they’re deleting reviews speaking up about it or what, but it is absolutely disgusting. Thousands of photos. Thousands of videos. Thousands of memories. Literally ALL GONE without any type of response.

Horrible.

title: All of our photos are lost!
text: Do not trust the app. Because of the system error, our photos and cherished moments are completely deleted and cannot be recovered and that's without any backup. We did not even receive any notification email about this deletion before it happened so maybe we can back up the information somewhere else or maybe we even can consider buying the plus version! There is only a small declaration notice in the app and without checking the app on a daily basis or actively searching for such deletion notification, you won't even know there's such a big system problem! Having been using this app for 8 years I'm completely devastated and disappointed!

title: Nearly perfect app
text: I will answer your question of “why only one star?” In just a moment. First off I have to say that my partner and I were looking for an app that did exactly what this one does. We tried several apps and this was the one. Loved all of the features, especially the shared calendar. Loved the peace of mind we had that we were only sending messages to each other. Completely removing that odd paranoia for us. The one thing that takes this from a perfect app to a 1 star app is the fact that after paying for lifetime premium, EVERYTIME I open the app there are red dots in two places implying that something is unread. When I tap on those places I am informed about a new sticker/pack that is available for purchase. I get that those red dots are to increase engagement. But after paying that much money to still be advertised to feels like a genuine crime. Please make it so those red dots can be at the very least turned off, after premium purchase or don’t make them a thing. I don’t mind that you sell extras. But please do not advertise them to me after paying for the app. Doing so would make this an easy 6 star app for me.

title: DO NOT trust this app.
text: Since 2017, my husband and I used Between as our photo and video album. Every precious experience (including our photos from our wedding and honeymoon) got stored there, with the understanding that it was safe storage. We loved the format of the albums. We looked back at our memories frequently. Today, Between informed users that all non-paying users had their photos and videos deleted by accident and the data is not recoverable. Nothing but an apology has been offered for this devastating loss. DO NOT TRUST BETWEEN WITH YOUR CHERISHED PHOTOS AND CONVERSATIONS.

title: No ads if you pay? Lies.
text: It advertises that you will not receive any ads if you pay for the premium version. However, once you pay for the premium version, you realize that the only ad you can remove is the home banner. The app continues to notify you constantly to pay for stickers. It’s constant spam, while using the app. I get it. The creators of the app want to keep making money off of sticker purchases. But…if folks pay for the premium version to avoid ads, then get rid of all the ads. Yes that includes your ads/constant notifications buy stickers. Super lame.
